apps.name: Dwn
apps.description: Videos, songs, playlists and transcripts from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, SoundCloud and over a thousand other sites, plus whole Google Drive and Dropbox folders without split zips. No accounts, no servers.
highlights: Paste a link, pick a format, done
Up to 4K and 8K, MP3, WAV or a transcript
Whole cloud folders, never split zips

apps.name: Tag
apps.tagline: Take the AI tags off your photos and videos.
apps.description: Strips C2PA Content Credentials, “made with AI” labels and generator metadata from photos and videos. Lossless: nothing is re-encoded and your originals are never touched.
highlights: Drop photos, videos or whole folders
See every AI and C2PA tag a file carries
Higgsfield, Firefly, OpenAI, Midjourney and more

apps.name: Lut
apps.tagline: Match the colour of one shot to another.
apps.description: Drop a reference with the look you want and the clips to grade. Lut matches white balance, saturation and contrast, then hands you a .cube LUT for Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut plus a graded copy. Runs on your computer; originals are never touched.
highlights: Drop a reference, then your clips
Live before and after for every clip
A real 33-point .cube LUT for any editor
Graded copies in H.264, HEVC or ProRes

apps.name: Stm
apps.tagline: Split any song into vocals, drums, bass and other.
apps.description: Drop in songs and Stm separates them into vocals, drums, bass and other with the htdemucs model, on your Mac's Neural Engine or your PC's GPU. Keep all four, just vocals and instrumental, or pull out one stem. Runs on your computer; nothing is uploaded.
highlights: Vocals, drums, bass and other, or a karaoke split
Runs on the Neural Engine or your GPU
WAV, FLAC or MP3 out, originals untouched
